    Construction

    The original Juris C-75 "The Plaintiff": a 2 in chambered mahogany body with a maple cap, on the geometric outline with heavy bevels on the top and back edges. Set mahogany neck at 4° with an ebony board, 24.75 in scale, '59 roundback profile; 3+3 Juris headstock with waisted sides and a gabled top, truss rod adjusted through a slot above the nut, and a riveted asset-tag badge.

    Hardware as built: TV Jones T-Armonds, wood-mount (no ears), on black base plates; a brass Compton one-piece compensated bridge on brass thumbwheels over a rosewood base; an Allparts short trapeze tailpiece. Amber speck ribbed knobs (Knobhead) for volume and tone, with a full-size Gretsch-tipped 3-way tone switch between them and the pickup selector on the bass horn, both under skirted dress nuts. Gold frets, rosewood truss rod cover, Electrosocket jack on the treble side. The top is stained walnut-brown; where the bevels cut through the maple cap it shows as a natural line round the edge (faux binding).
